title: The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Amane Fujimiya, a messy boy living alone, lends his umbrella on a rainy day to Mahiru Shiina, the admired 'angel' of his school, who turns out to be his next-door neighbor. To repay him she starts cooking and helping him keep house. A slow, gentle romance grows as each sees the other's hidden loneliness.
life_message: Small, steady acts of care can heal loneliness and grow into love.

content.note: Hints of estranged parents (AniList Estranged Family, spoiler).
Slow, chaste romance between neighbors; two teens alone in an apartment (Wikipedia; MangaUpdates Slow Romance).
Both leads cope with neglectful family backgrounds (to verify).
Teens living alone and sharing meals unsupervised.
